### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

> [!NOTE] > The current focus of LlamaIndex is to build the best AI-powered engine for document parsing and extraction. **[LlamaParse](https://cloud.llamaindex.ai?utm_medium=li_github&utm_source=github&utm_campaign=2026--)** is our enterprise platform for agentic OCR, parsing, extraction, indexing and more.
